answers.stem_only: Fargate tasks use awsvpc networking, so the ALB target group must use the ip target type. For a private image pull with no internet route, create interface VPC endpoints for com.amazonaws.region.ecr.api and ecr.dkr, plus an S3 gateway endpoint (image layers are stored in S3); only the endpoints needed, to keep the security review small. No public IPs, no NAT.

Use an Auto Scaling group capacity provider with managed scaling (target capacity 100 percent, so no spare instances are kept) in the service's capacity provider strategy, so ECS scales the group in when instances are idle; and use a binpack placement strategy (on memory or CPU) so tasks fill as few instances as possible and the rest become empty and can be removed.
